quote: For the treatment of urinary tract infections due to susceptible strains of the following organisms
note: Recurrent UTI is a subtype of the indicated urinary tract infections (combination product).

quote: Acute Sinusitis ( 1.12 )
note: Only acute sinusitis among URIs is indicated (respiratory indication is lower tract); 'upper respiratory infections' is an organ-system category.

quote: FASENRA is indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older with hypereosinophilic syndrome (HES)
note: Named indication.

quote: Ustekinumab is indicated for the treatment of adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis.
note: Named indication.

quote: INTRA-ABDOMINAL INFECTIONS, including peritonitis, intra-abdominal abscess, and liver abscess
note: Intra-abdominal abscess is named as an indicated infection.

quote: preoperatively in acute angle-closure glaucoma where lowering the intraocular pressure is desired before surgery
note: Acute angle-closure glaucoma named as a condition where the drug lowers IOP.

quote: indicated for treatment of adult patients with metastatic carcinoma of the colon or rectum
note: Colon carcinoma is a near parent of indicated metastatic colon carcinoma (EMA).

quote: BOTOX is indicated for the treatment of adults with cervical dystonia
note: Named indication.

quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and its extension, pulmonary embolism
note: Pulmonary venous thrombosis is literally a venous thrombosis; weak, likely intended as PE mapping.

quote: Amlodipine is indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure (1.1).
note: Hypertension indication exists only via amlodipine/atorvastatin combination label; counts per combo rule.

quote: indicated for the treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease in adults and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older
note: Named indication.

quote: indicated for the relief of symptoms of depression. Endogenous depression is more likely to be alleviated than other depressive states.
note: Endogenous depression named within the depression indication.

quote: 1.3 Prevention of Postmenopausal Osteoporosis
note: Indicated in conjugated estrogens/medroxyprogesterone (PREMPRO) combination label.

quote: Treatment of partial-onset seizures with or without secondarily generalized seizures in patients with epilepsy 4 years of age and older
note: Treatment of epileptic seizures is treatment of epilepsy.

quote: As adjunctive therapy for short-term administration ... in acute gouty arthritis; acute rheumatic carditis
note: Acute rheumatic carditis is a synonym of acute rheumatic heart disease.

quote: Saxagliptin tablets are not recommended for the treatment of type 1 diabetes mellitus or diabetic ketoacidosis.
note: Explicit limitation of use.
EMA text covers human COPD only; equine COPD (heaves) is a spurious veterinary mapping.

quote: treatment of adult patients with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG)-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC)
note: NMIBC is synonymous with superficial bladder carcinoma.

quote: Primary or secondary adrenocortical insufficiency (hydrocortisone or cortisone is the first choice
note: Primary adrenocortical insufficiency is listed among endocrine indications.

quote: Desipramine hydrochloride tablets, USP are indicated for the treatment of depression.
note: Depression = depressive disorder.
Supplied ethinyl estradiol text covers contraception only; PMDD/premenstrual not mentioned.

quote: For the temporary relief of ... general unrest and sleeplessness.
note: Homeopathic combination products list sleeplessness (insomnia) as a relieved condition.

quote: RYSTIGGO is indicated for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adult patients
note: Named indication.

quote: Atenolol tablets USP are indicated for the long-term management of patients with angina pectoris.
note: Named indication.

quote: JOURNAVX is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe acute pain, including postoperative pain, in adults.
note: Neck pain is not named; accepted only as a narrower form of indicated acute pain (borderline).

quote: Pheochromocytoma Propranolol is indicated as an adjunct to alpha-adrenergic blockade to control blood pressure and reduce symptoms of catecholamine-secreting tumors.
note: Adjunctive management of pheochromocytoma under its own heading.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic liposarcoma who have received a prior anthracycline-containing regimen
note: Named indication.

quote: acute treatment of intermittent, stereotypic episodes of frequent seizure activity ... in patients with epilepsy 12 years of age and older
note: Epilepsy is only the population for seizure-cluster rescue (age 12+); absence epilepsy not mentioned.

quote: indicated for the maintenance of remission of ulcerative colitis in adult patients who are intolerant of sulfasalazine
note: Label is ulcerative colitis only; generic 'colitis' is an overbroad class.

quote: Cabometyx is indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic differentiated thyroid carcinoma (DTC)
note: Named EMA indication.

quote: indicated for the prophylaxis of the nasal symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis
note: Management of SAR symptoms counts as treating SAR.

quote: They are also indicated in chronic anterior uveitis
note: Chronic iritis is chronic anterior uveitis (neomycin/corticosteroid combination).

quote: Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura in adults Secondary thrombocytopenia in adults
note: Thrombocytopenia is a near parent of listed indicated forms.
Label indicates systemic hypertension only; pulmonary arterial hypertension is not mentioned and not a subtype.

quote: allergic corneal marginal ulcers
note: Edge is a near parent of the listed allergic corneal marginal ulcers; infectious ulcers are not covered.

quote: indicated in the treatment of acute symptomatic episodes of hypoglycemia
note: Named indication.

quote: temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: headache
note: Tension-type headache is a subtype of the OTC headache indication.

quote: indicated in adults (≥ 18 years of age) with infections caused by designated, susceptible bacteria
note: Generic 'Infection' is a whole disease class; label covers specific bacterial infections.
